recipes.promptAddendum: The whole group is drawn large, about three quarters of the image wide, and touches no edge of the image. There is no snow anywhere.
recipes.notes: The side view instead of low top-down, which is what draws the isometric slab; no snow.

Pixen stands the gravestones on an isometric slab whatever the text says (graveyard-stones-a to -d and the two edits). The generator of the forest clumps draws free-standing things with nothing under them: the class calm-markers now generates with it, in the chibi style layer. The same request was first tried once through scripts/art/chibi-mountain-ranges.ts in a scratch run; those sixteen candidates were not kept (the generator is not deterministic, this call drew others).

Bead pulp_wars-2yc.15 (the user, 2026-10-06: 'the graveyard is better than it was but looks a bit basic and boring'): the same free-standing class with a richer subject: a small mausoleum, a leaning cross, a cracked slab, a dead tree with a raven, a lantern with a violet glow, a wisp of mist.

graveyard-rich-a drew the right things (mausoleum, leaning cross, cracked slab, tree with raven, violet lantern) but filled the image to its edges (a group 78 to 80 px wide, pieces cut off) in a mid slate that sinks into the ashen ground. The subject now names five things, a paler stone (#aab2c2) and a wide empty margin.

graveyard-rich-b fits the tile and candidate 0 is pale enough for the ashen ground, but every candidate has one or two gravestones only (a crypt and a tree with one cross). The subject now places the mausoleum and the tree at the back and three different stones and the lantern in front, all in the pale stone.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only the colours and the sail cloth of this windmill: the tower becomes dark slate-grey stone (#5a5f6b), the cone roof near-black charcoal (#2b2b31), the four sails become ragged torn charcoal-grey cloth with holes and tattered edges on dark wooden arms, and the small window glows violet (#a221ee). Nothing is red, cream or terracotta any more. Keep the windmill's shape, size, the X of four sails, the door, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: The Undead Windmill as an edit of the accepted shared Windmill, so the canvas, footprint and silhouette stay.
